findings.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:486: Reminder cancellation promises are neither awaited nor included in prismaPromises, allowing the handler to finish before reminders are cancelled or deleted and leaving cancelled-booking notifications active. The modified rescheduling and workflow-update loops have the same omission.

packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:57: A single failed cancellation request aborts the loop, skipping remaining reminders and the final Promise.all for queued database deletions. A persistently failing reminder can block other cancellations on every run; failures must be handled per reminder and successful cancellations persisted independently.

goldens.comment: Asynchronous functions deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are called without await inside forEach loops. This occurs during booking rescheduling/cancellation, and workflow/workflow step deletion/updates. Consequently, scheduled workflow reminders may not be reliably cancelled, potentially leaving them active.

When immediateDelete is true, the deleteScheduledEmailReminder function cancels the SendGrid email but fails to delete the corresponding WorkflowReminder record from the database. This creates orphaned database entries and is inconsistent with the immediateDelete: false path, which marks the record as cancelled. The SendGrid DELETE API call is also omitted in this path.

The 'cancelled' field is nullable, which can lead to existing records having null values instead of a default of false. This can cause incorrect behavior in the application when checking the cancellation status of reminders.

adjudication_records.issue_text: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:57: A single failed cancellation request aborts the loop, skipping remaining reminders and the final Promise.all for queued database deletions. A persistently failing reminder can block other cancellations on every run; failures must be handled per reminder and successful cancellations persisted independently.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in scheduleEmailReminders.ts lines 52-75, the code iterates through remindersToCancel with a for...of loop, making await calls to client.request() for each reminder. If any single client.request() call throws an error, the entire try block exits to the catch block, which only logs the error. This means: 1) Any reminders after the failed one won't be processed, 2) The workflowRemindersToDelete array won't contain all successful deletions, 3) The Promise.all(workflowRemindersToDelete) at line 72 won't execute for any reminders. The finding correctly identifies that a single failure aborts processing of remaining reminders, and there's no per-reminder error handling to ensure successful cancellations are persisted independently.
